units.source_text: 小皇子已遭母丧，皇上颇思留他在身边。

en.t: The young prince had already lost his mother, and the Emperor very much wished to keep him by his side.

units.source_text: 可是丧服中的皇子留侍御前，古无前例，只得准许他出居外家。

en.t: But there was no precedent for a prince in mourning clothes to remain in attendance before the throne, so the Emperor had no choice but to allow him to go live with his mother's family.

units.source_text: 小皇子年幼无知，看见众宫女啼啼哭哭、父皇流泪不绝，童心中只觉得奇怪。

en.t: The young prince was too small to understand; seeing all the court ladies weeping and his father endlessly shedding tears, his childish heart only found it strange.

units.source_text: 寻常父母子女别离，已是悲哀之事，何况死别又加生离呢！

en.t: Even an ordinary parting between parents and children is already sorrowful, so how much more when separation by death is followed by separation in life!
